description: Irish Building Energy Rating Database - (Cleaned 05/10/2023) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Ciara Ahern, Kumar Raushan (Technological University Dublin College of Engineering and Built Environment). Found in the database of the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland, other than occasional erroneous entries, when a field is unknown the chosen default imputed values used are based on pessimistic estimates. Especially with the economic bounce back in Ireland, these values have become unrepresentative and skewed. Coverage: national (IE); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
